at selection-screen.
***Begin of addition by Ekta.
  authority-check object 'V_VBAK_VKO'
           id 'ACTVT' field '03'.
  if sy-subrc ne 0.
    message e001(0) with 'You are not authorized user to run this report'.
  endif.
****End of addition by Ekta.
  "Selektionsdatum ins Memory schicken
  set parameter id '1)9' field p_dat.
  getknumh = oldknumh.

  import t180-aktyp from memory id 'RV_COND_MEMORY_02'.

  loop at screen.
    if ( sen_idoc is initial or getknumh is initial )
                             and screen-group1 = 'NA'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if not getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-required = '1'.
    endif.
    if getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'DAS'. "Gültig beibehal
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if getknumh ne space and screen-group1 = 'DAS' and
                       t180-aktyp ne 'X'.
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if not getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'NB'. " Schalter
      screen-invisible = '1'.
    endif.
    if ( sen_idoc ne space or getknumh ne space )
                        and screen-group1 = 'IA'.  " Zeitintervall
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    modify screen.
  endloop.

      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if not getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'KN'. " Gültig am
      screen-required = '1'.
    endif.
    if getknumh is initial and screen-group1 = 'DAS'. "Gültig beibehal
      screen-invisible = '1'.
      screen-active    = '0'.
      p_print = 'X'.
    endif.
    if getknumh ne space and screen-group1 = 'DAS' and

  data   datlow   like   vake-datab.

    endif.

    dathigh ='99991231'.

      tables

        wrong_intervall = 01
        wrong_option    = 02
        wrong_sign      = 03.

    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      message e106.
    endif.
  else.
    dathigh = datlow.
  endif.

        if vor is initial and nach is initial.

                bzirk in l_2     and
                werks in l_4     and
                katr4 in l_10     and
                /scl/carb in l_12     and
                /scl/psize in l_15     and
                /scl/ptype in l_14     and
                /scl/slun in l_16     and
                kfrst in l_25     and
                    datab >= datlow  and  datab <= dathigh and
                kappl = 'V'.

        elseif nach is initial.
          select * from a551
                into corresponding fields of table t_header_a551
                for all entries in itab_kschl
                where  kschl eq itab_kschl-kschl and
                kschl in kschl     and

                where  kschl eq itab_kschl-kschl and

* consider the TEXT flag                                               *
  data: dummy.
* fill the t681e                                                       *
  t681e-kvewe = 'A'.
  t681e-kotabnr = '551'.
  clear kschl_tmp.
  clear tmp_%%%kschl.
  loop at t_pos_a551.
    if t_pos_a551-kschl <> kschl_tmp.
* Fill Text for KSCHL on Position Level if Requested                   *
      select single * from t681u into t681u_tmp
         where kvewe = 'A'
         and konli = konli_tmp+16(2)
         and fieldname = 'KSCHL'
         and ( kotex = '2'
         or kotex = '3' ).
      if sy-subrc = 0.
        move t_pos_a551-kschl to t_pos_a551-%%%kschl.
        perform text_suche using 'KSCHL' 'V' 'A'
                        changing   t_pos_a551-%%%kschl
                                   dummy.
        modify t_pos_a551.
        move t_pos_a551-kschl to kschl_tmp.
        move t_pos_a551-%%%kschl to tmp_%%%kschl.
      endif.
    else.
      move tmp_%%%kschl to t_pos_a551-%%%kschl.
      modify t_pos_a551.
    endif.
  endloop.
* consider the flag on the position level                              *
  loop at t_pos_a551.
* fill the komg                                                        *
    move-corresponding t_pos_a551 to komg.
* fill the konp                                                        *
    read table t_konp with key knumh = t_pos_a551-knumh
                               kopos = t_pos_a551-kopos
                           binary search.
    move-corresponding t_konp to konp.
    move t_pos_a551-%kfrst
    to komg-kfrst.
    move t_pos_a551-%kfrst
    to konp-kfrst.
* get the text for the each field                                      *
    if not komg-vkorg is initial.
    endif.
    if not komg-bzirk is initial.
    endif.
    if not komg-werks is initial.
    endif.
    if not komg-katr4 is initial.

      perform text_suche using 'KATR4' 'V' 'A'
                                    changing
                                    t_pos_a551-tkatr4
                                   dummy.

    endif.
    if not komg-/scl/carb is initial.
      perform text_suche using '/SCL/CARB' 'V' 'A'
                                    changing
                                    t_pos_a551-t/scl/carb
                                   dummy.

    endif.
    if not komg-/scl/psize is initial.
      perform text_suche using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'V' 'A'
                                    changing
                                    t_pos_a551-t/scl/psize
                                   dummy.

    endif.
    if not komg-/scl/ptype is initial.
      perform text_suche using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'V' 'A'
                                    changing
                                    t_pos_a551-t/scl/ptype
                                   dummy.

    endif.
    if not komg-/scl/slun is initial.
      perform text_suche using '/SCL/SLUN' 'V' 'A'
                                    changing
                                    t_pos_a551-t/scl/slun
                                   dummy.

    endif.
    if not komg-kfrst is initial.
    endif.
    modify t_pos_a551.
  endloop.

form callback_user_command using ucomm like sy-ucomm
                           rs_selfield type slis_selfield.

  data: found(1) type c.
  data: lt_xvake type standard table of vakevb with header line,
        lt_xkonp type standard table of konpdb with header line,
        lt_xkonh type standard table of konhdb,
        lt_ykonp type standard table of konpdb with header line,
        lt_ykonh type standard table of konhdb,
        lt_xstaf type standard table of condscale,
        lt_xkondat type standard table of vkondat,
        lt_ykondat type standard table of vkondat,
        lt_time_vake_db type standard table of vakedb.
  data: lv_counter type i,
        lv_answer(1).

*---- macro defination for the jump in the condition screen            *
  define jump.
    call function 'SD_JUMP_TO_COND'
      exporting
        knumh         = &1-knumh
        datbi         = &1-%%datbi
        kopos         = &1-kopos
        condition_use = 'A'
        first_screen  = 'A'
        maintain_mode = &2
      exceptions
        others        = 0.
  end-of-definition.
  define jump_to_cond.

*--- call the condition screen                                         *
    read table &1 index rs_selfield-tabindex.
    jump &1 &2.

  end-of-definition.                   " JUMP_TO_COND

  define check_auth.
    call function 'SD_COND_AUTH_CHECK'
      exporting
        i_vkorg      = komg-vkorg
        i_vtweg      = komg-vtweg
        i_spart      = komg-spart
        i_kschl      = auth_check-kschl
        i_kvewe      = auth_check-kvewe
        i_kappl      = auth_check-kappl
        i_kotabnr    = auth_check-kotabnr
        i_ekorg      = auth_check-ekorg
        i_activity   = &1
      exceptions
        no_authority = 1
        others       = 2.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      message id sy-msgid type 'E' number sy-msgno
          with sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.
    endif.
  end-of-definition.

  define delete_cond.
    refresh: lt_xkonp, lt_ykonp, lt_xvake.
    loop at t_pos_&1.
      read table t_konp with key
           knumh = t_pos_&1-knumh
           kopos = 1
           binary search.
      check sy-subrc eq 0 and t_konp-loevm_ko is initial.
      move-corresponding t_konp to lt_ykonp.
      append lt_ykonp.
      lt_xkonp = lt_ykonp.
      lt_xkonp-loevm_ko = 'X'.
      lt_xkonp-updkz = 'U'.
      append lt_xkonp.
      move-corresponding t_pos_&1 to lt_xvake.
      move-corresponding t_pos_&1 to komg.
      perform fill_vakey_from_komg
              in program rv13&1
              using lt_xvake-vakey komg.
      lt_xvake-kvewe = 'A'.
      lt_xvake-kappl = 'V'.
      lt_xvake-kotabnr = &2.
      append lt_xvake.
    endloop.
    describe table lt_xvake lines sy-fdpos.
    if not sy-fdpos is initial.
      add sy-fdpos to lv_counter.
      call function 'RV_KONDITION_SICHERN_V13A'
        exporting
          change_docs_write = 'X'
          use_outbound_call = 'X'
        tables
          db_time           = lt_time_vake_db
          db_xkonh          = lt_xkonh
          db_xkonp          = lt_xkonp
          db_xstaf          = lt_xstaf
          db_ykonh          = lt_ykonh
          db_ykonp          = lt_ykonp
          db_xkondat        = lt_xkondat
          db_ykondat        = lt_ykondat
          db_xvake          = lt_xvake.
    endif.
  end-of-definition.

* +         WHEN  'T_POS_A551'.                                        *
  if ucomm eq 'ADD' and rs_selfield-tabname eq 'T_POS_A551'.
    read table t_header_a551 with key
         knumh = t_pos_a551-knumh.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      read table t_header_a551 with key
         %%%%no = t_pos_a551-%%%%no.
    endif.
    check sy-subrc eq 0.
    move-corresponding  t_header_a551  to komg.
    auth_check-kschl = t_header_a551-kschl.
    auth_check-kvewe = 'A'.
    auth_check-kappl = 'V'.
    auth_check-kotabnr = '551'.
    move t_pos_a551-%%%kfrst
    to  komg-kfrst.
    move t_pos_a551-%%vkorg
    to komg-vkorg.
    move t_pos_a551-%%bzirk
    to komg-bzirk.
    move t_pos_a551-%%werks
    to komg-werks.
    move t_pos_a551-%%katr4
    to komg-katr4.
    move t_pos_a551-%%/scl/carb
    to komg-/scl/carb.
    move t_pos_a551-%%/scl/ptype
    to komg-/scl/ptype.
    move t_pos_a551-%%/scl/psize
    to komg-/scl/psize.
    move t_pos_a551-%%/scl/slun
    to komg-/scl/slun.

    check_auth '02'.
* +STOP                                                                *
*      endcase.                                                        *
*         jump_to_cond t_pos_&kotab 'D'. "wrong doesn´t work properly  *
* set the parameter for the Selection screen                           *
    set parameter id '1)9' field t_pos_a551-datab.
    set parameter id 'KDA' field t_pos_a551-datab.
    if not komg-vkorg is initial.
      set parameter id 'VKO'
      field komg-vkorg.
    endif.
    if not komg-bzirk is initial.
      set parameter id 'BZI'
      field komg-bzirk.
    endif.
    if not komg-werks is initial.
      set parameter id 'WRK'
      field komg-werks.
    endif.
* set the parameter for the call to XK14                               *
    set parameter id 'KAP' field 'V'.   " Kond.Applikation
    if t_pos_a551-kopos eq 1 and
               not t_pos_a551-kschl is initial.
      set parameter id 'VKS' field t_pos_a551-kschl. " Kond.Art
    else.
      data   aline_a551 like line of t_pos_a551.
      loop at t_pos_a551 into aline_a551
         where knumh = t_pos_a551-knumh and
               kopos = 1.
        if not aline_a551-kschl is initial.
          set parameter id 'VKS' field aline_a551-kschl.
          exit.
        endif.
      endloop.
    endif.
* +           SET PARAMETER ID 'KON' FIELD '551'.  " Tabelle nr.       *
    clear bdcdata.
    bdcdata-fnam     = 'RV13A-KOTABNR'.
    bdcdata-fval     = '551'.  " Tabelle nr.
    append bdcdata.
    bdcdata-fnam     = 'bdc_okcode'.
    bdcdata-fval     = '    '.
    append bdcdata.

    call transaction 'XK14' using bdcdata mode 'E'.
* +           CALL TRANSACTION 'XK14' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.           *
  endif.

* transport the conditions                                             *
*  IDOC are defined only for the Usage A and E (Bonus)                 *
* +     WHEN 'TRAN'.                                                   *
  if ucomm eq 'TRAN'.
    data: p_mestyp like edidc-mestyp value 'COND_A',
          p_logsys like tbdls-logsys value space.
    data: begin of gt_knumh occurs 10.
            include structure vkkacondit.
    data: end of gt_knumh.
    data: fields like sval occurs 2 with header line.
    data: returncode(1)       type c,
          popup_title(30)     type c,
          idoc_to_send(1)     type c.
* Prepare the data to be send                                          *
    p_mestyp = 'COND_A'.
    export p_mestyp to memory id 'COND_A_MEM'.
* check if the table GT_knumh is filled or not                         *
    read table gt_knumh index 1.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.  " not filled
      perform fill_cond_idoc tables gt_knumh.
    endif.

    read table gt_knumh index 1.
    if sy-subrc = 0.  " till yet not any data send
      popup_title = 'Sendeparameter angeben'(103).
      refresh fields.
      clear fields.
      fields-tabname    = 'TBDME'.
      fields-fieldname  = 'MESTYP'.
      fields-value      = p_mestyp.        "Vorbesetzung im Popup
      fields-field_obl  = 'X'.             "Muß-Feld
      append fields.
      clear fields.
      fields-tabname    = 'TBDLS'.
      fields-fieldname  = 'LOGSYS'.
      fields-field_obl  = ' '.
      append fields.
* use the standard pop with the report std report Rv130004 for cond.   *
      call function 'POPUP_GET_VALUES_USER_HELP'
        exporting
          popup_title    = popup_title
          programname    = 'RV130004'
          formname       = 'EXAMPLE_EXIT'
          f4_programname = 'RV130004'
          f4_formname    = 'EXAMPLE_F4'
        importing
          returncode     = returncode
        tables
          fields         = fields.

      if returncode <> space.
        message e751.
      endif.

      loop at fields.
        if fields-tabname   = 'TBDME' and
           fields-fieldname = 'MESTYP'.
          p_mestyp = fields-value.
        elseif fields-tabname   = 'TBDLS' and
               fields-fieldname = 'LOGSYS'.
          p_logsys = fields-value.
        endif.
      endloop.

*  authority check für Stammdatenversendung                            *
      authority-check object 'B_ALE_MAST'
                id 'EDI_MES' field p_mestyp.
      if sy-subrc <> 0.
        message e250.
      else.
*  muß der Message-Typ überhaupt versendet werden                      *
        clear idoc_to_send.
        call function 'ALE_MODEL_DETERMINE_IF_TO_SEND'
          exporting
            message_type           = p_mestyp
            receiving_system       = p_logsys
            validdate              = sy-datum
          importing
            idoc_must_be_sent      = idoc_to_send
          exceptions
            own_system_not_defined = 1
            others                 = 2.
        if sy-subrc <> 0 or idoc_to_send <> 'X'.
          message id 'VJ' type 'E' number '000'
                  with p_mestyp p_logsys.
        else.
* jetzt endlich das IDoc erzeugen                                      *
*             SET PF-STATUS 'NONO' OF PROGRAM 'SAPLV130'.              *
          call function 'RV_CONDITION_GET_CUA_REPO'
            exporting
              pfkey_i = 'NONO'
              title_i = 'R'.
* +              PAR1_I  = KSCHL                                       *
* +              PAR2_I  = T685T-VTEXT                                 *
* +              PAR3_I  = SPACE                                       *
*               PAR4_I  = SPACE.                                       *
          call function 'RV_CONDITION_SET_CUA_REPO'.
          call function 'MASTERIDOC_CREATE_COND_A'
            exporting
              pi_mestyp                 = p_mestyp
              pi_logsys                 = p_logsys
              pi_direkt                 = 'X'
            tables
              pit_conditions            = gt_knumh
            exceptions
              idoc_could_not_be_created = 1.
          if sy-subrc <> 0.
            message s751.
          else.
            commit work.
            message s750.
          endif.
        endif.
      endif.
    endif.
* +   ENDCASE.                                                         *
  endif.                                                    "TRAN
endform.                    "CALLBACK_USER_COMMAND

*       FORM EVENT_END_OF_FIRST_LIST                                  **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**

form event_end_of_first_list.
  data:    et_events_line type slis_alv_event.
* event fühlen                                                         *
  clear et_events_rest[].
  clear et_events_rest.
  clear et_events_line.
  et_events_line-name = slis_ev_top_of_page.
  et_events_line-form = 'EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST'.
  append et_events_line to et_events_rest.

*--- macro defination to call the print_next_list_alv                  *
  define  print_next_list_of.
    data: tmp_table_&1 like line of header_list_&1.
    read table header_list_&1 into tmp_table_&1
               index sorttab-ltabix.
    perform print_next_list_alv
      tables   tmp_table_&1-table[]  t_pos_&1
      using    fieldcat_&1     it_sort_&1   et_events_rest
               'T_HEADER_&1'    'T_POS_&1'  is_print_axxx.
  end-of-definition.

  data   oldtabix   like sy-tabix.
  define  print_next_simple_list_of.
    clear  oldtabix.
    data: tmp_table_&1 like line of header_list_&1.
    data table_&1 like t_pos_&1[] with header line.
    refresh table_&1.
    read table header_list_&1 into tmp_table_&1
               index sorttab-ltabix.
    data: line_&1  like line of header_list_&1-table.
    loop at tmp_table_&1-table into line_&1.
*    DATA TABLE_&1 LIKE T_POS_&1[] WITH HEADER LINE.                   *
      loop at t_pos_&1 where %%%%no = line_&1-%%%%no.
        append t_pos_&1 to table_&1.
      endloop.
    endloop.
    move table_&1[] to pos_list_&1-table[].
    append pos_list_&1.
    splitt_tab_name-kotab = '&1'.
    splitt_tab_name-no = sy-tabix.
    data alo_fieldcat_&1 like line of fieldcat_&1.
    alo_fieldcat_&1-tabname = splitt_tab_name.
    modify fieldcat_&1 from alo_fieldcat_&1
         transporting tabname where tabname ne ' '.
    data alo_sort_&1 like line of it_sort_&1.
    alo_sort_&1-tabname = splitt_tab_name.
    modify it_sort_&1 from alo_sort_&1
         transporting tabname where tabname ne ' '.
    perform print_next_simple_list_alv
      tables  pos_list_&1-table[]
     using    fieldcat_&1     it_sort_&1   et_events_rest
              'T_POS_&1' is_print_axxx.
  end-of-definition.

  loop at sorttab.
    check sorttab-out is initial.
    check sy-tabix > 1.
* set the mark flag                                                    *
    sorttab-out = 'X'.
    modify sorttab transporting out.

    case sorttab-axxx.
      when 'A551'.
* +      IF SORTTAB-AXXX EQ 'A551'.                                    *
*    DATA: TMP_TABLE_A551 LIKE LINE OF HEADER_LIST_A551.               *

      when 'A552'.

*               INDEX SORTTAB-LTABIX.                                  *
*    PERFORM PRINT_NEXT_LIST_ALV                                       *
*      TABLES   TMP_TABLE_A810-TABLE[]  T_POS_A810                     *
*      USING    FIELDCAT_A810     IT_SORT_A810   ET_EVENTS_REST        *
*               'T_HEADER_A810'    'T_POS_A810'.                       *

        print_next_simple_list_of a810.
* +     ENDIF.                                                         *
      when 'A811'.
* +      IF SORTTAB-AXXX EQ 'A811'.                                    *
*    DATA: TMP_TABLE_A811 LIKE LINE OF HEADER_LIST_A811.               *
*    READ TABLE HEADER_LIST_A811 INTO TMP_TABLE_A811                   *
*               INDEX SORTTAB-LTABIX.                                  *
*    PERFORM PRINT_NEXT_LIST_ALV                                       *
*      TABLES   TMP_TABLE_A811-TABLE[]  T_POS_A811                     *
*      USING    FIELDCAT_A811     IT_SORT_A811   ET_EVENTS_REST        *
*               'T_HEADER_A811'    'T_POS_A811'.                       *

        print_next_simple_list_of a811.
* +     ENDIF.                                                         *
      when 'A812'.
* +      IF SORTTAB-AXXX EQ 'A812'.                                    *
*    DATA: TMP_TABLE_A812 LIKE LINE OF HEADER_LIST_A812.               *
*    READ TABLE HEADER_LIST_A812 INTO TMP_TABLE_A812                   *
*               INDEX SORTTAB-LTABIX.                                  *
*    PERFORM PRINT_NEXT_LIST_ALV                                       *
*      TABLES   TMP_TABLE_A812-TABLE[]  T_POS_A812                     *
*      USING    FIELDCAT_A812     IT_SORT_A812   ET_EVENTS_REST        *
*               'T_HEADER_A812'    'T_POS_A812'.                       *

        print_next_simple_list_of a812.
* +     ENDIF.                                                         *
      when 'A813'.
* +      IF SORTTAB-AXXX EQ 'A813'.                                    *
*    DATA: TMP_TABLE_A813 LIKE LINE OF HEADER_LIST_A813.               *
*    READ TABLE HEADER_LIST_A813 INTO TMP_TABLE_A813                   *
*               INDEX SORTTAB-LTABIX.                                  *
*    PERFORM PRINT_NEXT_LIST_ALV                                       *
*      TABLES   TMP_TABLE_A813-TABLE[]  T_POS_A813                     *
*      USING    FIELDCAT_A813     IT_SORT_A813   ET_EVENTS_REST        *
*               'T_HEADER_A813'    'T_POS_A813'.                       *

        print_next_simple_list_of a813.
* +     ENDIF.

*MOD 002 Start of changes
      when 'A776'.
        print_next_simple_list_of a776.
*MOD 002 End of changes

    endcase.
  endloop.

* THIS IS LIKE THE END OF LAST LIST EVENT                              *
* clear the out fields                                                 *
  data line_cnt like sy-tabix.
  describe table sorttab lines line_cnt.
  read table sorttab index line_cnt.
  if sorttab-out = 'X'.
    loop at sorttab.
      clear sorttab-out.
      modify sorttab.
      case sorttab-axxx.
        when 'A551'.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_AXXX                                   **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form event_top_of_list_axxx.

  data: dummy.
  data: it_list_commentary type slis_t_listheader,
        it_list_commentary_line type slis_listheader.
  data: l_titel like dd04v-scrtext_m.

  clear it_list_commentary_line.
  refresh it_list_commentary.
  it_list_commentary_line-typ = 'S'.

  data sorttab_tabix like sy-tabix value 0.

  sorttab_tabix = 1.
  read table sorttab index sorttab_tabix.
  sorttab-out = 'X'.
  modify sorttab index 1 transporting out.
  move-corresponding sorttab to komg.
  clear konp-kschl.
  move-corresponding sorttab to konp.


  call function 'REUSE_ALV_COMMENTARY_WRITE'
    exporting
      it_list_commentary = it_list_commentary
    exceptions
      others             = 1.
endform.                    "EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_AXXX


*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST                                   **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form event_top_of_list_rest.

  data: dummy.
  data: it_list_commentary type slis_t_listheader,
        it_list_commentary_line type slis_listheader.
  data: l_titel like dd04v-scrtext_m.

  clear it_list_commentary_line.
  refresh it_list_commentary.
  it_list_commentary_line-typ = 'S'.

  data sorttab_tabix like sy-tabix value 0.

  loop at sorttab.
    if sorttab-out = 'X'.
      sorttab_tabix = sy-tabix.
    else.
      exit.
    endif.
  endloop.
* if nothing is found, then print the last name                        *
  if sorttab_tabix = 0.
    describe table sorttab lines sorttab_tabix.
  endif.

  read table sorttab index sorttab_tabix.

  move-corresponding sorttab to komg.
  clear konp-kschl.
  move-corresponding sorttab to konp.


  call function 'REUSE_ALV_COMMENTARY_WRITE'
    exporting
      it_list_commentary = it_list_commentary
    exceptions
      others             = 1.
endform.                    "EVENT_TOP_OF_LIST_REST




define    get_scale.
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
  if not par_staf is initial.
    read table t_scale with key
       knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
      if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
        t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
      else.
        write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
      endif.
      case t_konp-stfkz.
        when ' '.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
        when 'A'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
        when 'B'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
        when 'D'.
          t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
      endcase.
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
            t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
            t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
        tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
        move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
        if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
          write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                  to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
        else.
          write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                  to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
        endif.
        append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
        t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
        read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
      endwhile.
    else.
      append t_pos_axxx.
    endif.
  else.
    append t_pos_axxx.
  endif.
end-of-definition.


*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A551                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a551
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a551[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a551[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a551 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'BZIRK' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'WERKS' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A551'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A551

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**

                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.

                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.

                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A552'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.

        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A552'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.

      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *

        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.

          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =

          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =

          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =

          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =

* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *

        perform get_ref_forcurrper

                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A552

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A553                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a553
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a553[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a553[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a553 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'WERKS' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A553'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A553

          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr3. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr3.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
              t_header_axxx-katr3.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A555

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A556                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a556
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a556[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a556[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a556 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'WERKS' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR3' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A556'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr3. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr3.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.

*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *

              t_header_axxx-vkorg.

          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'BZIRK' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/OPMARKET' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR3' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A573'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr3. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr3.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
              t_header_axxx-katr3.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A573
