              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A603

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A604                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a604
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a604[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a604[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a604 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'BZIRK' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A604'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A604

        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A606

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A607                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a607
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a607[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a607[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a607 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'BZIRK' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A607'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A607

          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr3.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
              t_header_axxx-katr3.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A609

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A610                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a610
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a610[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a610[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a610 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'BZIRK' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR3' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A610'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr3. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr3.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.

          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.

*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos

                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).

              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr3 =
              t_header_axxx-katr3.

              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.

                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A612'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A612'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
          t_pos_axxx-bzirk. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-bzirk.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%bzirk =
              t_header_axxx-bzirk.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A612

        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A659'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A659'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A659

                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A752'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A752

      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a755 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KDKG5' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A755'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kdkg5 =
          t_pos_axxx-kdkg5. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-kdkg5.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kdkg5 =
              t_header_axxx-kdkg5.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A755

                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A757

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A758                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a758
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a758[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a758[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a758 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR7' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A758'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr7 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr7. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr7.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr7 =
              t_header_axxx-katr7.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A758

              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A760

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A761                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a761
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a761[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a761[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a761 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'WERKS' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/CARB' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/BRAND' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PSIZE' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/PTYPE' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/SLUN' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A761'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
          t_pos_axxx-werks. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-werks.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/carb.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/brand.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/ptype.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/psize.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/slun.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%werks =
              t_header_axxx-werks.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A761
