          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/carb =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/carb.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/brand =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/brand.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/ptype =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/ptype.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/psize =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/psize.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/slun =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/slun.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl2 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl2.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A809

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM GET_LIST_POS_A810                                         *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       get the positikon table for the listviewer                    **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  --> T_HEADER_AXXX                                     *             *
*  -->  T_POS_AXXX                                                    **
*  -->  T_KONP                                                        **
*  -->  T_SCALE                                                       **
*  -->  PAR_STAF                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form get_list_pos_a810
               tables  t_header_axxx like t_header_a810[]   "Changi
                       t_pos_axxx    like t_pos_a810[]     "Changin
                       t_konp       like t_konp[]         "USING
                       t_scale      like t_scale[]        "USING
               using   par_staf        type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a810 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/CCC/GEOLVL1' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/OPCHANNEL' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/OPMARKET' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KATR4' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A810'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
          t_pos_axxx-katr4. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl1 =
          t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-katr4.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%katr4 =
              t_header_axxx-katr4.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opmarket =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opmarket.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/opchannel =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/opchannel.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/ccc/geolvl1 =
              t_header_axxx-/ccc/geolvl1.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A810

       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a812 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKBUR' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KUNRG' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using '/SCL/TRADENAME' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A812'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
          t_pos_axxx-vkbur. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kunrg =
          t_pos_axxx-kunrg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/tradename =
          t_pos_axxx-/scl/tradename. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkbur.
            clear t_pos_axxx-kunrg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-/scl/tradename.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkbur =
              t_header_axxx-vkbur.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kunrg =
              t_header_axxx-kunrg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%/scl/tradename =
              t_header_axxx-/scl/tradename.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.
endform.                    "GET_LIST_POS_A812

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_REF_FORCURRPER                                       *
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text                                                           *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_T_KONP-KONWA  text                                         *
*      <--P_T_POS_AXXX-%%KONWA  text                                   *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form get_ref_forcurrper using    us_konwa   like konp-konwa
                        changing ch_%%konwa like konp-konwa.

  constants curr_per(5) value '3    '.

  if us_konwa eq '%'.
    ch_%%konwa = curr_per.
  else.
    ch_%%konwa = us_konwa.
  endif.

endform.                               " GET_REF_FORCURRPER





*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM TEXT_SUCHE                                               **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  -->  BEGRIFF                                                       **
*  -->  APPL                                                          **
*  -->  VEWE                                                          **
*  -->  LANG_TEXT                                                     **
*  -->  DDLEN                                                         **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form text_suche using     begriff      appl    vewe
                changing  lang_text    ddlen.
  data: no type c  value space.
  data: begin of dat_feld,
          fix(5),
          sefeld like t681e-sefeld.
  data: end of dat_feld.
  data: hold_subrc like sy-subrc.
  data: hold_tabix like sy-tabix.
  data: hold_kschl like a004-kschl.
  data: hold_knuma like kona-knuma.
  data: hold_text like dd04v-scrtext_l.
  data: dummy.
  tables:  t685t.
  data komg_tmp like komg.

  field-symbols: <b>.

  data: begin of text_tab occurs 10,
                 begriff like dntab-fieldname,
*****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_1 Conversion **Begin of change by EJX9007366 2026.05.27  for ATC
*                 kuerzel like konh-vakey,
                 kuerzel type vakey_long,
*****Code Remediation changes S4 2025_1 Conversion **End of change by EJX9007366 2026.05.27 for ATC
                 lang_text like dd04v-scrtext_l,
        end of text_tab.


  if  begriff eq 'KNUMA'.

  elseif begriff ne 'KSCHL'.

    data: begin of key_text_tab,
                   begriff like dntab-fieldname,
                   kuerzel like komg-matnr,
          end of key_text_tab.

    clear key_text_tab.
    move begriff    to key_text_tab-begriff.
    move lang_text  to key_text_tab-kuerzel.

    read table text_tab with key key_text_tab binary search.
    if sy-subrc eq 0.
      move text_tab-lang_text to lang_text.
    else.

      move sy-subrc to hold_subrc.
      move sy-tabix to hold_tabix.
      if begriff eq 'MATNR'.
        komg_tmp = komg.
        clear komg.
        komg-matnr = komg_tmp-matnr.
      endif.

      move 'KOMG-' to dat_feld.
      move begriff to dat_feld+5.
      assign (dat_feld) to <b>.
*      MOVE LANG_TEXT TO <B>.                                          *

*      PERFORM GET_PARAMETER(SAPMV13A) USING BEGRIFF.                  *
      write <b> to lang_text.
* Ermitteln des Textes                                                 *
      if not <b> is initial.
        perform feld_pruefung(sapmv13a)
                            using begriff no sy-subrc.
        perform fill_default(sapmv13a)
                            using begriff no lang_text dummy.
      endif.
      if sy-subrc eq 0.
        clear text_tab.
        sy-fdpos = strlen( lang_text ).
        write sy-fdpos to ddlen.
        move lang_text to text_tab-lang_text.
        move begriff   to text_tab-begriff.
        write <b>      to text_tab-kuerzel.
        if hold_subrc eq 4.
          insert text_tab index hold_tabix.
        endif.
        if hold_subrc eq 8.
          append text_tab.
        endif.
      endif.
      if begriff eq 'MATNR'.
        komg = komg_tmp.
      endif.
    endif.
  else.
    if lang_text ne hold_kschl.
      move lang_text to hold_kschl.
      select single * from t685t where spras eq sy-langu
                                   and kappl eq appl
                                   and kvewe eq vewe
                                   and kschl eq lang_text.

      if sy-subrc eq 0.
        assign (t685t-vtext) to <b>.
        assign  t685t-vtext  to <b>.
        write <b> to lang_text.
        move lang_text to hold_text.
      endif.
    else.
      move hold_text to lang_text.
    endif.
  endif.
endform.                    "TEXT_SUCHE

data:  begin of titel_tab occurs 0,
           key   like dntab-fieldname,
           titel like dd04v-scrtext_m,
       end of titel_tab.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM TITEL_SUCHE                                              **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form titel_suche using     begriff
                changing  titel.
  data: no type c  value space.
  data: hold_subrc like sy-subrc,
        hold_tabix like sy-tabix.
  data: l_dd04v like dd04v.
  data: l_tabname like dd02l-tabname.

  read table titel_tab with key = begriff binary search.
  if sy-subrc eq 0.
    move titel_tab-titel to titel.
  else.
    move sy-subrc to hold_subrc.
    move sy-tabix to hold_tabix.
    clear titel.

    if begriff eq 'KSCHL'.
      l_tabname = 'T685'.
    else.
      l_tabname = 'KOMG'.
    endif.
    call function 'SD_GET_DESCRIPTION_OF_FIELD'
      exporting
        i_fieldname = begriff
        i_tabname   = l_tabname
      importing
        e_dd04v     = l_dd04v
      exceptions
        others      = 1.
    if sy-subrc eq 0.
      write l_dd04v-scrtext_m to titel.
    endif.
    if not titel is initial.
      move titel to titel_tab-titel.
      move begriff   to titel_tab-key.
      if hold_subrc eq 4.
        insert titel_tab index hold_tabix.
      endif.
      if hold_subrc eq 8.
        append titel_tab.
      endif.
    endif.
  endif.
endform.                    "TITEL_SUCHE

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

  data      first_entry   type  c.

*---  data declaration                                                 *

  data :  table_a604 like t_header_a604[] with header line.
  data :  table_a605 like t_header_a605[] with header line.
  data :  table_a606 like t_header_a606[] with header line.
  data :  table_a607 like t_header_a607[] with header line.
  data :  table_a608 like t_header_a608[] with header line.
  data :  table_a609 like t_header_a609[] with header line.
  data :  table_a610 like t_header_a610[] with header line.

*--- macro for the split                                               *
  define split_table.
* set the variables to initial state                                   *
    clear last_tabix.
    clear first_entry.
    clear sorttab.
* for each header entry                                                *
    loop at t_header_&1.
      if
        1 = 2.

* if not the first entry, then set the to index and append the list    *
        if not first_entry is initial.
          last_tabix = sy-tabix.
          sorttab-to = last_tabix - 1.
          header_list_&1-table = table_&1[].
          append header_list_&1.
          clear table_&1[].
          sorttab-ltabix = sy-tabix.
          append sorttab.
        endif.
* move to sorttab                                                      *
        move-corresponding t_header_&1 to sorttab.
        sorttab-axxx = '&1'.
        if last_tabix is initial.
          sorttab-from = sy-tabix.
        else.
          sorttab-from = last_tabix.
        endif.
        first_entry = 'X'.
      endif.
* move the entry to spliteed table                                     *
      move t_header_&1 to table_&1.
      append table_&1.
    endloop.

* append the last entry                                                *
    if not first_entry is initial.
      clear sorttab-to.
      header_list_&1-table = table_&1[].
      append header_list_&1.
      clear table_&1[].
      sorttab-ltabix = sy-tabix.
      append sorttab.
    else.                              "sorttab is stil initial
      describe table t_header_&1 lines line_cnt.
      if line_cnt ne 0.   "if anything to add
        header_list_&1-table = t_header_&1[].
        append header_list_&1.
        sorttab-ltabix = sy-tabix.
        clear sorttab-to.
        sorttab-from = 1.
        sorttab-axxx = '&1'.
        append sorttab.
      endif.
    endif.

  end-of-definition.

*----------- split the tables                                          *
  split_table  a551.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM PRINT_FIRST_LIST_ALV                                     **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       ........                                                      **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*  -->  SORTTAB_AXXX                                                  **

*  -->  VALUE(TABNAME_HEADER_AXXX)                                    **
*  -->  VALUE(TABNAME_ITEM_AXXX)                                      **
*  -->  VALUE(IS_PRINT_AXXX)                                          **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form print_first_list_alv
      tables
              sorttab_axxx
              t_pos_axxx
     using    value(fieldcat_axxx)      type  slis_t_fieldcat_alv
              value(layout_axxx)        type  slis_layout_alv
              value(it_sort_axxx)       type  slis_t_sortinfo_alv
              value(et_events_axxx)     type  slis_t_event
              value(tabname_header_axxx) type  slis_tabname
              value(tabname_item_axxx)  type  slis_tabname
              value(is_print_axxx)      type  slis_print_alv.

       exporting

            i_callback_program       = '/CCC/RDOTCSLSR_CCCIL_PRICNG_S5'
            i_callback_user_command  = 'CALLBACK_USER_COMMAND'
            i_callback_pf_status_set = 'CALLBACK_STATUS'
            it_fieldcat              = fieldcat_axxx
            it_excluding             = ex_fcode
            is_layout                = layout_axxx
            it_sort                  = it_sort_axxx
            it_events                = et_events_axxx
            it_event_exit            = et_event_exit
            i_tabname_header         =  tabname_header_axxx
            i_tabname_item           =  tabname_item_axxx
            is_keyinfo               = keyinfo
            is_print                 = is_print_axxx
*    IMPORTING                                                         *
*         E_EXIT_CAUSED_BY_CALLER  =                                   *
*         ES_EXIT_CAUSED_BY_USER   =                                   *
       tables
            t_outtab_header          = sorttab_axxx
            t_outtab_item            = t_pos_axxx
       exceptions
            program_error            = 1
            others                   = 2.

*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
*       FORM FIELD_CHECK                                              **
*---------------------------------------------------------------------**
form field_check using iv_begriff
                       iv_kvewe type kvewe
                       iv_kotab type kotab
                 changing ev_error type xfeld.
  local: t681e.
  data: no type c value space.
  data: lv_kotabnr type kotabnr.
  data: komg_tmp like komg.

  check: iv_kvewe eq 'A'.
  lv_kotabnr = iv_kotab+1.
  select single * from t681e
   where kvewe = 'A'
     and kotabnr = lv_kotabnr
     and sefeld = iv_begriff.
  if iv_begriff ne 'KNUMA' and iv_begriff ne 'KSCHL'.
    if iv_begriff eq 'MATNR'.
      komg_tmp = komg.
      clear komg.
      komg-matnr = komg_tmp-matnr.
    endif.
    perform feld_pruefung(sapmv13a)
            using iv_begriff no sy-subrc.
  endif.
  if sy-subrc ne 0.
    ev_error = 'X'.
  else.
    clear ev_error.
  endif.
  if iv_begriff eq 'MATNR'.
    komg = komg_tmp.
  endif.
endform.                    "FIELD_CHECK

include /ccc/rdotcslsr_cccil_pricngf01.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  GET_LIST_POS_A776
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_T_HEADER_A776  text
*      -->P_T_POS_A776  text
*      -->P_T_KONP  text
*      -->P_T_SCALE  text
*      -->P_PAR_STAF  text
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
form get_list_pos_a776  tables   t_header_axxx like  t_header_a776[]
                                 t_pos_axxx like t_pos_a776[]
                                 t_konp like t_konp[]
                                 t_scale like t_scale[]
                        using    par_staf type c.

  data: tmp_tabix_konp   like sy-tabix.
  data: tmp_tabix_scale  like sy-tabix.
  data: old_knumh        like konp-knumh.
  data: old_kopos        like konp-kopos.
  data: lv_error         type xfeld.

  loop at t_header_axxx.
    old_knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
    t_pos_axxx-%kfrst =
    t_header_axxx-kfrst.
    read table t_konp with key
       knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh
       kopos = 1
       binary search.
    if sy-subrc ne 0.
      delete t_header_axxx.
    else.
      if not p_delete is initial.
        clear lv_error.
        clear komg.
        move-corresponding t_header_a776 to komg.
        move t_konp to konp.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'VKORG' 'A' 'A776'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KDGRP' 'A' 'A776'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'MATNR' 'A' 'A776'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
        if lv_error is initial.
          perform field_check using 'KFRST' 'A' 'A776'
                  changing lv_error.
        endif.
* Only incorrect records                                               *
        if lv_error is initial.
          delete t_header_axxx.
          continue.
        endif.
        clear sy-subrc.
      endif.
*----------- loop through all corresponding konp fields                *
      while sy-subrc eq 0 and
        t_konp-knumh = t_header_axxx-knumh.
        tmp_tabix_konp = sy-tabix.
*----------- get the Axxx fields                                       *
        if old_knumh ne t_pos_axxx-knumh.
          move-corresponding t_header_axxx to t_pos_axxx.
          t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
          t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
          t_pos_axxx-vkorg. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%kdgrp =
          t_pos_axxx-kdgrp. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
          t_pos_axxx-matnr. "hiden one for sort
          t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
          t_header_axxx-kfrst.
* don´t copy the datab and datbi fields to the suplimentary cond.      *
          if t_konp-kopos ne 1.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datab.
            clear t_pos_axxx-datbi.
            clear t_pos_axxx-vkorg.
            clear t_pos_axxx-kdgrp.
            clear t_pos_axxx-matnr.
            clear t_pos_axxx-%kfrst.
          endif.
        endif.
*----------- get konp fields                                           *
        move-corresponding t_konp to t_pos_axxx.
        perform get_ref_forcurrper
                 using t_konp-konwa
                 changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
        if t_konp-kopos = 1.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = t_konp-kschl.
        else.
          t_pos_axxx-%kschl = '    ->'.
          write t_konp-kschl to t_pos_axxx-%kschl+7.
          read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh
          kopos = 1 binary search.
          t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.
          read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
        endif.
*        get_scale.                                                    *
*************** Begin Scale handling                                   *
*----------- get scale fields                                          *
        if not par_staf is initial.
          read table t_scale with key
             knumh = t_konp-knumh  kopos = t_konp-kopos
             binary search.
          if sy-subrc eq 0.
*------------------ Prepare scale                                      *
            if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
              t_pos_axxx-%%sun = t_konp-konws.
            else.
              write t_konp-konms to t_pos_axxx-%%sun.
            endif.
            case t_konp-stfkz.
              when ' '.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'A'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'ab...'(00d).
              when 'B'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
              when 'D'.
                t_pos_axxx-%%stfkz = 'bis..'(00e).
            endcase.
            while sy-subrc eq 0 and
                  t_scale-knumh = t_konp-knumh   and
                  t_scale-kopos = t_konp-kopos.
              tmp_tabix_scale = sy-tabix.
              move-corresponding t_scale to t_pos_axxx.
              if t_scale-%%skz = 'W'.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbw currency t_konp-konws
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              else.
                write t_pos_axxx-kstbm unit t_konp-konms
                        to t_pos_axxx-%%sba.
              endif.
              read table t_konp with key knumh = t_konp-knumh  "CL
              kopos = 1 binary search.                         "CL
              t_pos_axxx-kschl = t_konp-kschl.                 "CL
              read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.          "CL
              append t_pos_axxx.
* clear the unnecessary column                                         *
              clear t_pos_axxx.
              t_pos_axxx-%%vkorg =
              t_header_axxx-vkorg.
              t_pos_axxx-%%kdgrp =
              t_header_axxx-kdgrp.
              t_pos_axxx-%%matnr =
              t_header_axxx-matnr.
              t_pos_axxx-%%%kfrst =
              t_header_axxx-kfrst.
              perform get_ref_forcurrper using t_konp-konwa
                       changing t_pos_axxx-%%konwa.
***+START  CHECK_IF_CURR_TAB_HAS_DATE(RV12LGEN)                        *
***+        T_POS_AXXX-%%DATBI = SORTTAB_AXXX-DATBI.                   *
              t_pos_axxx-%%datbi = t_header_axxx-datbi.
              add 1 to tmp_tabix_scale.
              read table t_scale index tmp_tabix_scale.
            endwhile.
          else.
            append t_pos_axxx.
          endif.
        else.
          append t_pos_axxx.
        endif.
**************  End of scale handling                                  *
        add 1 to tmp_tabix_konp.
        clear t_pos_axxx.
        read table t_konp index tmp_tabix_konp.
      endwhile.
    endif.
  endloop.

endform.                    " GET_LIST_POS_A776
